Callout.Name: Missing Ranch Hand
Callout.Message: Ranch hand not returned from checking fences.
Callout.Advisory: On foot, no phone signal in the area.

Script.Line: He has not come back from the fence line and that is four hours.
His quad is still in the barn. So he is on foot.
He does not carry a phone and it has never mattered before.

Lines.Approach: They went out to check fences this morning and they have not come back. No signal out there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
